cards.headline: Ophthalmologists' Perspectives on Cataract Surgery Sedation: A National Survey Study

source.title: Ophthalmologists' Perspectives on Cataract Surgery Sedation: A National Survey Study.
source.publisher: Journal of cataract and refractive surgery
source.excerpt: With appropriate training and favorable Medicare policies to make OBS financially viable and safe, ophthalmologists may be willing to assume additional, selected sedation roles traditionally performed by anesthesia teams.

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Cataract Surgery: A Review of Preoperative, Intraoperative and Postoperative Applications.
source.excerpt: This narrative summarises the current and emerging applications of AI in preoperative, intraoperative and postoperative management of cataracts.

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Neuroradiology: Transforming Diagnosis, Prognostication, and Workflow.
source.publisher: The Indian journal of radiology & imaging
source.excerpt: Emerging evidence suggests that the role of the neuroradiologist is transitioning toward a collaborative human-AI paradigm, rather than one of displacement.

source.title: Nationalpark Donau-Auen
source.excerpt: Der Nationalpark Donau-Auen ist ein 9600 ha großer Nationalpark, der sich von Wien bis zur Mündung der March in Niederösterreich an der Staatsgrenze zur Slowakei erstreckt. Er ist eine der größten weitgehend intakten Aulandschaften Mitteleuropas entlang der Donau.

cards.headline: OpenEvidence versus Six Leading Large Language Models in Refractive Surgery

source.title: OpenEvidence versus Six Leading Large Language Models in Refractive Surgery: Does Curated Medical Evidence Confer an Advantage?
source.publisher: Journal of cataract and refractive surgery
source.excerpt: OpenEvidence demonstrated significantly lower accuracy than the six evaluated general-purpose LLMs and did not exceed the BCSC Self-Assessment program user benchmark on this standardized refractive surgery multiple-choice assessment.

source.title: Artificial intelligence in dentistry: A cross-domain bibliometric analysis of technologies, functional applications, and dental specialties.
source.excerpt: This study provides an integrated perspective on how dental AI is developing across clinical domains. The findings highlight established imaging-based pathways and emerging opportunities for multimodal, externally validated, and clinically meaningful AI systems, thereby informing future research planning and clinical translation in dentistry.

cards.headline: Early emotional interventions for post-stroke functional prognosis

source.title: Early emotional interventions for post-stroke functional prognosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Early emotional interventions significantly improve functional recovery after stroke, with the greatest benefit observed for cognitive behavioral therapy and combined interventions initiated within 2 weeks of stroke onset. These findings support the integration of targeted emotional interventions into early standard care.

source.title: Turkmenistan
source.excerpt: Turkmenistan ist ein Staat in Zentralasien. Turkmenistan liegt am Kaspischen Meer und grenzt an Kasachstan im Nordwesten, Usbekistan im Nordosten, Afghanistan im Südosten, Iran im Süden und über eine Seegrenze durch das Kaspische Meer an Aserbaidschan im Westen. Der Binnenstaat ist mit 488.100 km² etwa so groß wie Spanien und landschaftlich vor allem von der Wüste Karakum geprägt.

source.title: Artificial intelligence in myeloproliferative neoplasms: From digital bone marrow pathology to clinical decision support.
source.excerpt: As multimodal data integration, foundation models, and generative approaches mature, AI has the potential to support a faster, more objective, and more personalized diagnostic and decision-making pathway in MPN.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Diabetic Foot Ulcer Care

source.title: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Diabetic Foot Ulcer Care: Advances in Diagnosis, Treatment, Prognosis, and Novel Therapeutic Strategies.
source.publisher: Journal of diabetes science and technology
source.excerpt: Despite promising advances, several challenges impede clinical translation, including data standardization, model explainability, regulatory compliance, clinical workflow integration, prospective validation, and equitable implementation.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence as a Catalyst for Cell-Based Therapies in Retinal Disease

source.title: Artificial Intelligence as a Catalyst for Cell-Based Therapies in Retinal Disease.
source.excerpt: This review concludes that the strategic integration of AI has plausible potential to become supportive infrastructure for scalable and reproducible cell-based treatments for retinal diseases, although its necessity has not been demonstrated and prospective clinical validation is still required, and biological insight and rigorous empirical verification remain fundamental.

cards.headline: Generative artificial intelligence in lung cancer care

source.title: Generative artificial intelligence in lung cancer care: current applications, challenges, and future directions.
source.excerpt: Challenges related to evidence quality, data integration, safety, transparency, and regulatory oversight must be addressed before widespread clinical implementation.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence Applications in Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery-A Narrative Review

source.title: Artificial Intelligence Applications in Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery-A Narrative Review.
source.excerpt: AI may assist clinicians in diagnostic and treatment-related decision-making, but current evidence does not support its use as a replacement for comprehensive clinical assessment and professional judgment.

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Pharmaceutical Care: Transforming Drug Discovery, Development, and Patient-care Delivery.
source.excerpt: Successful implementation requires coordinated efforts across technological development, regulatory frameworks, healthcare professional training, and continuous validation protocols addressing technical, organizational, and ethical dimensions simultaneously.

cards.headline: außer denjenigen, die bereuen und verbessern und klar machen.

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:160
source.excerpt: إلا الذين رجعوا مستغفرين الله من خطاياهم، وأصلحوا ما أفسدوه، وبَيَّنوا ما كتموه، فأولئك أقبل توبتهم وأجازيهم بالمغفرة، وأنا التواب على من تاب من عبادي، الرحيم بهم; إذ وفقتُهم للتوبة وقبلتها منهم.

cards.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ وَبَيَّنُوا۟ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَتُوبُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَأَنَا ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
cards.translation: außer denjenigen, die bereuen und verbessern und klar machen. Ihre Reue nehme Ich an, Ich bin ja der Reue-Annehmende und Barmherzige.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?

cards.headline: Diejenigen aber, die ungläubig sind und als Ungläubige sterben …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:161
source.excerpt: إن الذين جحدوا الإيمان وكتموا الحق، واستمروا على ذلك حتى ماتوا، أولئك عليهم لعنة الله بالطرد من رحمته، وعليهم لعنة الملائكة والناس أجمعين.

cards.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَمَاتُوا۟ وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَعْنَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
cards.translation: Diejenigen aber, die ungläubig sind und als Ungläubige sterben, auf ihnen liegt der Fluch Allahs und der Engel und der Menschen allesamt,
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
